result.summary: Extracts the duplicated `BlockValidationStateCatcher` helper class into a dedicated header (`node/block_validation_state_catcher.h`) and reuses it across the block template manager, the `submitblock` RPC, and mining test utilities. Replaces separate boolean flags indicating whether a block was found with `std::optional<BlockValidationState>`.
result.problem: Three separate call sites independently defined duplicate `CValidationInterface` listeners to inspect validation results after processing blocks, creating unnecessary code duplication.
evidence: PR description references reviewer feedback pointing out duplicate implementations in PR #34644 and PR #35675
result.changed_since_previous: Reopened on a dedicated branch to replace closed PR #36389; no changes to the implementation.
result.card: Deduplicates the BlockValidationStateCatcher helper into a shared header (node/block_validation_state_catcher.h) across the block template manager, submitblock RPC, and test utilities. This addresses code duplication pointed out in review comments on earlier mining changes (#34644 and #35675). The change standardizes block validation outcome tracking using an optional state without changing caller behavior.

risk.why: A flaw in tracking block validation states could cause submitblock or the block template manager to misreport block validation outcomes.
